one_line: Human-agent collaborative narrated product-demo studio with shared WebMCP workspace.

leverage_evidence: Five named tools cover state, creation, narration updates, generation, and export.
Description says tools mutate the same backend/shared store as the human UI and export requires explicit human approval.
execution_rationale: The packet describes a coherent end-to-end pipeline and shared workspace, but no usable visual evidence was available in review.
execution_evidence: Description specifies planning, Playwright recording, narration, voice, ffmpeg render, and MP4 export.
Live demo is reported alive.
impact_rationale: Product-demo creation is a concrete recurring pain for product teams and the collaborative workflow directly addresses agent unreliability.
impact_evidence: Pitch targets narrated product demos and explicitly identifies agent UI flailing as the problem.
creativity_rationale: A shared human-agent demo-production workspace is a strong, purposeful synthesis of WebMCP and browser/video automation.
creativity_evidence: Combines structured agent control, human editing, browser recording, narration, and gated export in one workflow.

leverage_rationale: Structured client-side spatial primitives directly control state that is difficult for a general agent to target reliably through pixels and sliders.
leverage_evidence: Five specialized tools include classification filtering, bounding-box focus, cross-section slicing, and spatial annotation.
Description claims sub-10ms in-browser execution and bidirectional 3D feedback.
execution_rationale: The stated workflow is coherent and technically plausible, but completeness and visual operation cannot be confirmed from the inaccessible frames.
execution_evidence: Live demo reported alive.
Packet describes Three.js shaders, point classes, and collaborative feedback.
impact_rationale: Spatial engineering, GIS, surveying, and civil analysis have a concrete need for faster inspection of complex scans.
impact_evidence: Problem statement names BIM, GIS, utility audits, and structural analysis users.
creativity_rationale: Applying native agent tools to direct manipulation of a 3D point-cloud canvas is a notably original interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Specialized spatial primitives expose 3D inspection semantics rather than generic UI actions.
usability_note: Domain-specific primitives could reduce complex manual manipulation; visual usability not verified.
red_flags: No public repository; visual evidence could not be inspected.
advance_reason: High WebMCP leverage and strong domain fit make this a compelling candidate, with execution confidence reduced by unavailable images.

one_line: Evidence-bound provenance research workbench that keeps uncertainty and source boundaries explicit.
what_it_does: Lets agents and curators map source-linked ownership events, test gaps/conflicts, draft cited labels, and export only after human approval.
leverage_rationale: The core value is structured, bounded, auditable agent interaction with shared evidence state and enforced export constraints; generic UI driving cannot comparably guarantee these boundaries.
leverage_evidence: Nine tools cover graph/version state, bounded search, source locators, validation, hypothesis comparison, drafting, and controlled export.
Application quarantines instruction-like source text and blocks export after downgrade until human approval.
execution_rationale: The packet presents a unusually complete workflow with explicit failure handling and receipts, though frames were unavailable for confirmation.
execution_evidence: Fictional dossier, eight records, unresolved interval, downgrade behavior, and attributable receipt are all specified.
Public repository and live demo are reported.
impact_rationale: Provenance researchers, archivists, and curators have a real need to preserve evidence, uncertainty, and auditability against unsupported narratives.
impact_evidence: Workflow directly addresses incomplete records, conflicting interpretations, unsupported claims, and provenance export.
creativity_rationale: The concept makes epistemic boundaries and adversarial source content first-class product behavior, an ambitious and memorable use of WebMCP.
creativity_evidence: Preserves an unresolved wartime interval and compares conservative versus attractive unsupported hypotheses.
Treats embedded SYSTEM text as quarantined evidence rather than instruction.
usability_note: Explicit graph, ledger, receipts, and human approval are well matched to high-stakes research workflows.
red_flags: Visual frame sheets unavailable for inspection.
advance_reason: Exceptional leverage, impact, and originality; one of the strongest packets even with visual verification unavailable.

what_it_does: Places and connects components, runs digital logic simulations, verifies a half-adder, and exports Arduino/ESP32 firmware through WebMCP.
leverage_rationale: Graph-level component and pin operations are substantially more precise and repeatable than an agent manipulating a circuit canvas visually.
leverage_evidence: Tools operate on a live graph: placeComponent, connectPins, runLogicSimulation, exportFirmware.
Demo claims all four half-adder input combinations are verified before firmware export.
execution_rationale: The described central workflow has concrete intermediate verification and a clear output, suggesting strong scope completion.
execution_evidence: Half-adder example specifies components, simulation cases, expected Sum/Carry, and firmware export.
Agent Activity Console exposes calls, latency, payloads, and results.
impact_rationale: Hardware learners, makers, and prototypers benefit from shortening the path from intent to tested circuit and firmware.
impact_evidence: Product addresses manual circuit assembly, simulation, and separated firmware workflows.
creativity_rationale: Combining circuit topology, live signal propagation, simulation verification, and firmware generation under an agent-controlled graph is an ambitious synthesis.
creativity_evidence: Single live graph spans design, simulation, and deployment preparation.
usability_note: Activity console and presets support inspectability; visual proof unavailable.
red_flags: Visual evidence could not be inspected.
advance_reason: Strong, concrete agent-native developer workflow with credible execution claims.

execution_evidence: Video exists with 179 seconds and transcript narrates the workflow end to end.
